project_type: Python FastAPI backend (Autonomous AI Company OS)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), conftest.py fixtures, unittest.mock
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to verify all tests pass. 2. Verify new modules import cleanly.
setup_instructions: pip install -e '.[dev]' (already done). Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.12 pre-installed. cryptography package already available (used in governance/secrets/vault.py). Do NOT touch dashboard/ directory.
contribution_requirements: Type hints required, docstrings required, 100 char line length (ruff), Python 3.12 features (| union types). Each module independently testable.
key_patterns: Dataclasses with frozen=True for immutable records, str Enum for string enums, field(default_factory=...) for mutable defaults, __all__ in __init__.py, test files at tests/test_*.py using fixtures from conftest.py
directory_structure: src/nexus/ has: governance/ (policy, secrets, audit, rbac), triggers/ (scheduler, webhook, executor), tools/ (registry, executor, mcp_client, policy_engine, audit), memory/ (store, retriever, layered, reflector, dedup, promotion), adapters/ (provider_presets, registry, multiple adapters). Tests at tests/test_*.py (1651 existing tests).
